<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1000" height="110" viewBox="0 0 1000 110" role="img" aria-label="" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2b0006"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#080000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="flash" cx="50%" cy="60%" r="75%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ff2a2a" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ff2a2a" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="glow" x="-50%" y="-20%" width="200%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="b"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <style>
    .bolt { opacity: 0; animation: strike 4s infinite; }
    .b1 { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
    .b2 { animation-delay: 2.0s; }
    .b3 { animation-delay: 3.1s; }
    .sky { opacity: 0; animation: skyflash 4s infinite; }
    .s1 { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
    .s2 { animation-delay: 2.0s; }
    .s3 { animation-delay: 3.1s; }
    @keyframes strike {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
      3% { opacity: 1; }
      6% { opacity: 0.25; }
      9% { opacity: 1; }
      16% { opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes skyflash {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
      3% { opacity: 1; }
      6% { opacity: 0.3; }
      9% { opacity: 0.9; }
      20% { opacity: 0; }
    }
  </style>
  <rect width="1000" height="110" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <rect class="sky s1" width="1000" height="110" fill="url(#flash)"/>
  <rect class="sky s2" width="1000" height="110" fill="url(#flash)"/>
  <rect class="sky s3" width="1000" height="110" fill="url(#flash)"/>

  <g class="bolt b1" filter="url(#glow)">
    <path d="M220 0 L200 34 L220 40 L190 110" fill="none" stroke="#ff1f1f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M220 0 L200 34 L220 40 L190 110" fill="none" stroke="#ffe5e5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <g class="bolt b2" filter="url(#glow)">
    <path d="M520 0 L540 36 L518 44 L552 110" fill="none" stroke="#ff1f1f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M520 0 L540 36 L518 44 L552 110" fill="none" stroke="#ffe5e5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <g class="bolt b3" filter="url(#glow)">
    <path d="M800 0 L782 38 L804 44 L772 110" fill="none" stroke="#ff1f1f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M800 0 L782 38 L804 44 L772 110" fill="none" stroke="#ffe5e5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
